GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and was then bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # never a real threat

Away evenly. Rolled fwd & raced keenly behind leader on rail early . Tracked leader on inside until pushed out Two Wide @ 450m. Pushed to quicken @ 400m & 3 Wide (1L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 250m & held ground in last 200m. # Every Chance
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down last 10 Lengths Two Wide , Made Some Ground to 7 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground in Straight without ever passing a runner # last throughout

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths 3-4 wide, Drifted Back to 10 Lengths Four Wide turning, lost further ground in Straight # never on track

Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide overracing, in Two Wide by the 1100m, Moved Up to Turn then Hooked Out to 2 Lengths 3 Wide , hit Lead 175m, booted clear inside the 100m. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards questioned about stable rep. about it not leading. Stable rep. explained whilst it led last start, it was not intended to do so, but to be in a forward position. He added with blinkers off and from the Wide gate, instructions were similar to last start, and it settled better today than previously.] # bolted in
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Over-raced early. Raced three-wide without cover early. Laid in round home turn and in the early part of the home straight. When quest about horse not leading, stable rep explained whilst filly led last start on 22/2/26, not intention to do so, but to be in a forward position-said with blinkers off & from wide gate, instructs were similar to last start, and filly settled better than previously.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to lead Four Wide by a long neck settling down, pressed on and led Two Wide at the 1150m, Held Together in front & led rail by 0.75 Lengths turning, Headed 350m and Dropped Out from there. [Stewards: COT - To settle further forward. Led. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities. Rider could offer no explanation for its performance.] # worked hard early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: C/O/T-settle further forward. Led. A post-race vet exam revealed no abs. Rdr could offer no explanation for the performance.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: change of tactics to be ridden forward, Jumped Ok , Drifted Back Worse than midfield Two Wide 7 Lengths 800m, Hard Ridden from the corner and only battled away in Straight # only battled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: C/O/T-further forward. Bumped on jumping. Settled midfield. Rdr reported filly failed to muster speed early & obliged to settle further back than instructed.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 5 Lengths on fence overracing, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in straight. First start: Need to see again. (Blinkers FIRST TIME) # never a threat
